Gauge-Day Downwind Indicator

Source: R/gaugeday_downwind.R
gaugeday_downwind.Rd

This dataset contains binary indicators of whether each gauge-day observation is downwind of each ionizer during the 2013–2018 Oman rainfall enhancement trial, as used in the analyses of Chambers et al. (2022a,b).

Usage

gaugeday_downwind

Format

A binary matrix with 122259 rows (corresponding to gauge-days in oman dataset) and 10 variables:

H1, H2, H3, H4, H5, H6, H7, H8, H9, H10

Binary indicators for each ionizer, showing whether a gauge-day observation is downwind of that ionizer: 1 = downwind; 0 = not downwind; NA = ionizer not yet deployed

References

  • Chambers, R., Beare, S., Peak, S. and Al-Kalbani, M. (2022a) Nudging a Pseudo-Science Towards a Science—The Role of Statistics in a Rainfall Enhancement Trial in Oman. International Statistical Review, 90: 346–373.

  • Chambers, R., Ranjbar, S., Salvati, N., and Pacini, B. (2022b) Weighting, Informativeness and Causal Inference, with an Application to Rainfall Enhancement. Journal of the Royal Statistical Society Series A: Statistics in Society, 185: 1584–1612
